children: RNS Number : 9351S  HSBC Holdings PLC  01 September 2026
Notification of issuance of equity securities under block listing
This notification is being made in accordance with PRM 1.6.4, and covers the period 1 August to 31 August 2026 (the "Period").

HSBC Holdings plc (the "Company") issued 12,955 Ordinary Shares of US$0.50 each ("Ordinary Shares") during the period for issue under the HSBC Share Plan 2011 under the Company's existing block listing of shares for this purpose. The balance of the Company's block listing is detailed below.
The new Ordinary Shares will rank pari passu with the existing issued Ordinary Shares of the Company.
As at 31 August 2026, the issued share capital of the Company was 17,169,701,783 Ordinary Shares.
Ongoing obligations to issue shares in connection with the acquisition of HSBC Finance Corporation (formerly Household International Inc.)
HSBC Holdings Group Share Option Plan
HSBC International Employee Share Purchase Plan
